references.context: Graph theory on a loopless simple undirected graph: a circuit here is a nontrivial finite closed trail, namely a positive-length sequence of adjacent edges beginning and ending at the same vertex, traversing no undirected edge more than once. Unlike a simple cycle, other vertices may recur; distinguish graph circuits from matroid circuits and directed cycles.
